doc.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Current playing, teaching and Dizzy Gillespie
title: Hartford jazz festival and the Artists Collective
summary: McLean has never played the Hartford festival; the Artists Collective has brought in major players for thirty years.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Let’s go back to the beginning. Oh, there’s one other thing. There’s a jazz festival in Hartford this weekend. Have you played that festival before?
Never. I’ve never played that festival.
You care to comment on it?

Because most of the time it’s at a time when I’m either busy doing something else, or they just couldn’t work it out with Dollie to get it done. I’m not opposed to doing it. I’d be very happy to do it.
I saw it had kind of a fusion format or soft jazz format.

Yeah, well, that’s what they’re doing. What we’re trying to do here at the Artists Collective is just continue to do what we’ve been doing over 30 years. They just started doing this festival 3, 4 years, 5 years ago. But we’ve been bringing Dizzy and Sonny Rollins and Dexter and all these people here for 30 years, and we’re just continuing to do that. We just had the Heath brothers, gave them a tribute, Dr. Billy
Taylor, Toots Thielemans, a variety of musicians, Mulgrew, Michael Carvin, different people.
